WITH d AS (
  SELECT distregistry, affectedarea,
    0.6*(10*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric,0)
       + 3*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric,0)
       + 2*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric,0))
  + 0.4*((COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric,0))/3) AS dsi
  FROM disasterevents)
SELECT o.opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND(d.dsi,2) AS dsi
FROM operations o JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coordopsref=o.opsregistry
JOIN d ON d.distregistry=c.coord_dist_ref
WHERE d.dsi > 15000

SELECT ROUND(SUM((f.ops_costs_usd + f.transportcostsusd + f.storage_costs_usd + f.personnelcostsusd)::numeric) / SUM((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric), 2) AS cost_per_beneficiary
FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = f.findistref
WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed'

SELECT d.distregistry, d.haztype, d.affectedarea,
  ROUND(LEAST((s.foodtons*1000)::numeric / ((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric*2),
              s.water_liters::numeric / ((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric*3)),2) AS supply_sufficiency_days,
  ROUND(GREATEST(0, (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric - s.shelter_units),2) AS shelter_gap
FROM disasterevents d LEFT JOIN supplies s ON s.supply_dist_ref=d.distregistry

SELECT d.distregistry, d.affectedarea
FROM disasterevents d LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hrdistref=d.distregistry
WHERE ((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric + (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric) > 100
   OR (h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric + (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric,0) < 0.01

WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.opsregistry, d.affectedarea,
    ((10 - CASE o.priority_rank::text WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 4 END) * 0.5)
    + (COALESCE((h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'total')::numeric, 0) * 0.2)
    + (CASE d.impact_summary->'communication_and_transport'->>'transport_access' WHEN 'Minimal' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END * 30) AS gsi
  FROM operations o
  JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coordopsref = o.opsregistry
  JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = c.coord_dist_ref
  LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
  WHERE o.supply_flow_state = 'Disrupted'
    AND d.impact_summary->'communication_and_transport'->>'transport_access' = 'Minimal')
SELECT opsregistry, affectedarea, ROUND(gsi, 2) AS gsi FROM g ORDER BY gsi DESC

SELECT c.*
FROM coordinationandevaluation c
JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = c.coordopsref
JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref
JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref AND b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref
WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed'
  AND ( (t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_capacity'->>'daily_tons')::numeric / NULLIF(t.vehiclecount,0) < 1.0
     OR (0.4*(t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate')::numeric + 0.3*b.bene_feedbackscore*10 + 0.3*b.distequityidx*100) < 40 )

WITH d AS (
  SELECT distregistry,
    0.6*(10*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric,0)
       + 3*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric,0)
       + 2*COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric,0))
  + 0.4*((COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric,0)
       + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric,0))/3) AS dsi
  FROM disasterevents),
served AS (
  SELECT t.transport_hub_ref AS hubregistry, AVG(d.dsi) AS avg_dsi_served
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT transport_hub_ref, transportdistref FROM transportation) t
  JOIN d ON d.distregistry = t.transportdistref
  GROUP BY t.transport_hub_ref),
h AS (
  SELECT hb.hubregistry,
    0.5*((hb.hubutilpct::numeric/100) + (hb.stockturnrate::numeric/10)) + 0.5*s.avg_dsi_served AS hsi
  FROM distributionhubs hb LEFT JOIN served s ON s.hubregistry = hb.hubregistry)
SELECT hubregistry, ROUND(hsi,2) AS hsi,
  CASE WHEN hsi > 1000000 THEN 'Overwhelmed' ELSE 'Normal' END AS status
FROM h

WITH x AS (
  SELECT o.opsregistry, f.funding_state,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd,'$',''),',','')::numeric AS budget,
    (f.ops_costs_usd + f.transportcostsusd + f.storage_costs_usd + f.personnelcostsusd)::numeric AS total_costs,
    (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date) AS days
  FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
  WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Active'),
r AS (
  SELECT opsregistry, funding_state, (budget - total_costs) / NULLIF(total_costs / NULLIF(days,0), 0) AS runway FROM x)
SELECT opsregistry, funding_state, ROUND(runway,1) AS budget_runway_days
FROM r WHERE funding_state = 'Critical' AND runway < 7

WITH s AS (
  SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry,
    0.4*(t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate')::numeric + 0.3*b.bene_feedbackscore::numeric*10 + 0.3*b.distequityidx::numeric*100 AS res,
    (c.report_compliance::numeric + c.stakeholder_satisf::numeric*20 + c.dataqualityvalue*20) / 3.0 AS cqi
  FROM coordinationandevaluation c
  JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref AND b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref
  JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref)
SELECT opsregistry, ROUND(res,2) AS res, ROUND(cqi,2) AS cqi FROM s WHERE res > 75 AND cqi > 75 ORDER BY res DESC

WITH p AS (
  SELECT h.hr_ops_ref AS opsregistry,
    (h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric
      / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric + (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0) AS msr,
    CASE e.health_environment_profile->'health'->>'disease_risk' WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS disease_risk_score,
    100 - (e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'sanitation_coverage')::numeric AS sanitation_risk,
    100 - (regexp_replace(e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'water_quality_index', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'))::numeric AS water_quality_risk
  FROM humanresources h
  JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = h.hrdistref
  JOIN environmentandhealth e ON e.env_dist_ref = h.hrdistref),
s AS (
  SELECT opsregistry, ((1 - msr)*40) + (disease_risk_score*10) + (sanitation_risk*0.15) + (water_quality_risk*0.15) AS phrs FROM p)
SELECT opsregistry, ROUND(phrs,2) AS phrs FROM s WHERE phrs > 70
